why: The answer turns on root pressure being generated by the ACTIVE absorption of ions/water into the xylem by root cells, a water-relations fact that no chapter in the supplied list teaches.
note: Taxonomy gap: expected the chapter 'Transport in Plants' (topic: absorption of water by roots / root pressure and guttation). The supplied Biology list has 32 chapters and omits the NCERT chapters dropped in the 2023 rationalisation; Transport in Plants is one of them. Morphology of Flowering Plants ('The Root') and Anatomy of Flowering Plants cover root structure, not root pressure, so filing it there would be wrong.
